title: PSR placement picker shows jobs again for sanitary imports
description:
The DB3 importer placement picker could show an empty list when the active Plan Sync group was set to Sanitary. It was hiding every jobsite that did not already have sanitary pipes — so you could not pick a storm-only job to import sanitary into.

The picker now lists green PSR jobs regardless of whether that system branch already has segments, and falls back to all jobs if the group’s saved job keys do not match live records.

Who is affected: PipeSync Plan Sync DB3 importer on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh, open Upload/Update DB3, confirm the green job list loads, pick a job + Sanitary, then commit.
changeLog: Stop filtering placement picker by empty storm/sanitary segment arrays.
Fall back to all PSR jobs if active group job keys match nothing.
Clearer empty-state message when no jobs are loaded vs no search hits.
